I’ve been adding @cleanskinclub ‘s new Clean Makeup Wipes into my nighttime routine, and I’ve been loving the Healthy Aging wipes for my skin. They’re thick, gentle, and get my makeup off without the burning, tugging or sticky residue I’ve always hated with traditional makeup wipes.

#cleanskinclub
items.transcript: Come spend the evening with me. I've been running around all day, and before I can settle down for the night, I need to get a few things done around the house. I don't know what it is, but I cannot fully relax until everything's back where it belongs. So tonight, we're doing a quick little reset. Nothing too crazy, just getting everything cleaned up and ready for tomorrow. I feel like I've gotten into such a habit of doing this at night, because waking up to a clean house just makes the next morning so much easier. And now that the house is taken care of, it's finally time for a little self-care. Clean Skin Club came out with their new Clean Makeup Wipes, and I've been absolutely loving these. I picked up the healthy aging ones from Target. They're made with normal to dry and aging skin in mind, which is definitely what I'm looking for at this stage of my skincare routine. I've never really loved traditional makeup wipes. I hate when they burn around my eyes or leave my skin feeling dry or with that weird residue afterwards. But these are so nice. They're thick and lightly textured, so they actually remove my makeup without me feeling like I have to tug and scrub at my skin. And the biggest thing for me, no burning or stinging around my eyes. My skin just feels really soft and comfortable afterward. Then I just go right into the rest of my normal nighttime skincare routine. There's something about taking those few minutes at the end of the night to take care of my skin that just feels like the final part of resetting everything, including myself. And just like that, the house is reset, my skincare is done, and your girl is officially off duty.

 #skincare #selfcare #blackmomsofinstagram #cleanhome #organizedhome
items.transcript: My home isn't the only thing I like to keep clean. I also do not play about my skincare. I was on a brand trip recently, and we were running late, and I couldn't put on any makeup, but the skin was still giving. And we were cute. My besties have been asking for my skincare secrets, and ain't no gatekeeping over here. First and foremost, the water that you use on your face matters. So I use a Filter Baby filter on my faucet. Double cleansing really helps get everything, every bit of dirt and makeup off your face. I also like to use a microfoliant twice a week to sweep and polish my skin. Do y'all clean your nasal passages? You know you can have bad breath through your nose, right? Hit them entrances with a little cleanser. And all my lash girlies, be sure to keep them lashes clean. Lashes are made to keep debris out of your eyes. A lot accumulates there, including lash mites. And then when my skin is clean, I like to use a red light therapy mask to improve the firmness of my skin. We're aging, but gracefully. And beautiful skin comes from the inside out. So hydration is of utmost importance. I like to add these youthful skin electrolytes to sparkling water and also take my daily liposomal vitamin C and collagen support for healthy, glowing skin. Now for more skincare, which includes lip care. Tatcha has a duo that keeps my lips soft and supple. I like to start with my essence and lymphatic drainage tool that heats and vibrates. Eye cream is a must for the most delicate skin on your face. All good stuff that works while I sleep. My 11s won't catch me slipping. So I put some tape dots on and these micro needle patches under my eyes. And ever since I've lost 75 pounds, your girl's neck been looking a little saggy. So collagen neck mask it is. And y'all please use clean bonnets, pillowcases and sheets to prevent breakouts. Remember, self-care is filling up the cup you pour from.

items.caption: Apparently my purse has trust issues! Let’s just say every item in my bag now has a second job. Shop everything on my Amazon storefront and watch Ride or Die, now streaming on @primevideo #RideOrDieOnPrime #PrimeVideoCreator
items.transcript: Apparently my bag has trust issues. What's in my bag isn't what you think. Lip balm. Second, hand sanitizer because people. Hand cream because dry hands is never part of the plan. Now here's where things get a little different. The compact mirror, great for touch-ups. Also great for casually checking who's behind you without turning around. Totally normal. The scrunchie, because even my hair accessories have back-ups. And this lipstick, pretty shade, but the real surprise is what's inside. And this tactical pen looks like your regular pen, writes like your regular pen, but trust me, it's definitely doing more than taking notes. And the UV flashlight, let's just call it another tool for paying attention. Personal safety alarm, I'm not trying to fight anybody, I'm trying to attract witnesses. RFID blocking wallet, my information is expensive, we are not giving it away for free. Hidden camera detector, hotels, Airbnbs, I'd rather check and never find anything than wish I had. At this point, I'm honestly not sure if I carry a purse or a survival kit. People already say I'm type A, but after watching Ride or Die on Prime Video, apparently my bag became type A+. And honestly, I'm not mad about it.

Shop the Ninja Crispi DualZone through the link in my bio! ✨

@ninjakitchen #NinjaCrispiDualZone #KitchenReset
items.transcript: People always ask me how I keep my kitchen from getting out of control, and honestly, I rarely wait until after dinner. The moment dinner goes into my Ninja Crispy dual zone glass air fryer, I get to work. I love multitasking, so while dinner is crisping, I'm resetting my entire kitchen. I'm queen of clean up as you go. So as soon as I'm done prepping the food, I start. Today we're having sweet chili steak bites and roasted potatoes. You know you can never go wrong with a steak and potato combo. I just seasoned everything with a little smoked paprika, garlic salt, black pepper, herbs, and a drizzle of avocado oil, and in they go. I'll wipe down the counters, wash prep the dishes, put everything back where it belongs, and before I know it, both dinner and my kitchen are finished at the same time. One of my favorite parts is being able to actually watch everything crisp through the glass while I'm cleaning. It makes the whole process feel effortless. I've realized that taking care of tomorrow starts the night before. When dinner is ready, the kitchen is already clean. It's a small habit that's made such a big difference in my evenings. I'm not just making dinner, I'm taking care of tomorrow's me.
